items.title: Roy Carew Interview, 1964-11-28
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Shades of... Well, he's not... Coke. Well, he was a piano player from the West Coast.

ctx.x: I did not think much as far as playing of Jethro's music of that... That fellow. Shades of Jethro?
Shades of... Well, he's not... Coke. Well, he was a piano player from the West Coast. Yeah, that's right.
I just didn't think he had any... He just played...
